# ==========================================================================
# Inter-vFPGA P2P NoC — Network-3 streaming connections (AUTO-GENERATED by write_hdl).
# HUB-SHARED: P2P_N_SEND send-group NMUs (inst_p2p_nmu_XX) x P2P_N_HUB receive-hub
# NSUs (inst_p2p_nsu_XX) in the shell (see shell_top). Hub h serves vFPGAs
# [h*HUB_K .. h*HUB_K+HUB_K-1]; its NSU is tagged with that tdest RANGE, so an NMU
# packet with s_axis_tdest=v routes to hub v/HUB_K, whose demux forwards it to the
# local vFPGA v-h*HUB_K. Every send-group connects to every hub (any-to-any); with
# S,M <= 4 each endpoint has <= 4 connections (NoC AXIS cap is 16).
#
# create_noc_connection runs at synthesis_pre so the NoC is built into the shell
# netlist. Pattern mirrors the AMD RTL modular-NoC tutorial (Vivado-Design-Tutorials,
# Versal/Memory_and_NoC/NoC_Design_Flows/RTL/Foundational, AXIS MxN section).
# Positional wildcard lookup (get_noc_interfaces -filter {NAME =~ ..} matches nothing
# for NoC interfaces); leading * tolerates any shell hierarchy prefix.
# ==========================================================================
{% if cnfg.fdev == 'v80' and cnfg.en_p2p == 1 and cnfg.n_reg > 1 %}
{% set P2P_S  = [cnfg.n_reg, 4] | min %}
{% set P2P_M  = [cnfg.n_reg, 4] | min %}
{% set P2P_MK = (cnfg.n_reg + P2P_M - 1) // P2P_M %}
# --- send-group NMU handles + SLR1/SLR2 placement (LOCATION) ---
# Endpoints stay OUT of SLR0: a P2P NoC endpoint on an SLR0 tile blocks the
# CPM5(X0Y0)/PS9(X0Y0-2) ground tie-off -> [Route 35-534] Boundary Net GNDNet not
# completely routed (6492 CPM5 + 3020 PS9 unroutable pins). LOCATION on the NoC
# interface is the RTL-modular-NoC placement pin (validate_noc honors it); applied
# at synthesis_pre with the connections.
#
# SLR SPREAD: the first half of the send/recv hubs sit in SLR1 (NoC NMU row Y8 =
# CR row Y5; NSU row Y12 = CR row Y7), the second half in SLR2 (NMU row Y13 = CR
# row Y8; NSU row Y17 = CR row Y10). send-group k and recv-hub k share an index and
# serve the SAME vFPGAs [k*K .. k*K+K-1], so pairing NMU[k]+NSU[k] in one SLR pulls
# that whole vFPGA group into that SLR (the timing-driven placer follows the soft
# arbiter/demux links). Result: a SLR2 vFPGA reaches its hub WITHIN SLR2 and the
# hardened NoC -- not soft SLL links -- carries any inter-SLR P2P hop. The 8 tiles
# used here must also be inside pblock_inst_shell (see v80_static_floorplan.xdc).
{% for g in range(P2P_S) %}
set p2p_nmu_{{ g }} [get_noc_interfaces -quiet *inst_p2p_nmu_{{ '%02d' % g }}/S_AXIS_nmu]
{% if g * 2 < P2P_S %}
set_property LOCATION NOC_NMU512_X{{ g }}Y8 $p2p_nmu_{{ g }}
{% else %}
set_property LOCATION NOC_NMU512_X{{ g }}Y13 $p2p_nmu_{{ g }}
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
# --- receive-hub NSU handles + TDEST_ID range (hub h -> vFPGAs [h*MK, h*MK+MK-1]) + SLR1/SLR2 placement ---
{% for h in range(P2P_M) %}
set p2p_nsu_{{ h }} [get_noc_interfaces -quiet *inst_p2p_nsu_{{ '%02d' % h }}/M_AXIS_nsu]
set_property TDEST_ID {{ '0x%X' % (h * P2P_MK) }}:{{ '0x%X' % ([h * P2P_MK + P2P_MK - 1, cnfg.n_reg - 1] | min) }} $p2p_nsu_{{ h }}
{% if h * 2 < P2P_M %}
set_property LOCATION NOC_NSU512_X{{ h }}Y12 $p2p_nsu_{{ h }}
{% else %}
set_property LOCATION NOC_NSU512_X{{ h }}Y17 $p2p_nsu_{{ h }}
{% endif %}
{% endfor %}
# --- any-to-any: every send-group -> every hub ---
{% for g in range(P2P_S) %}
{% for h in range(P2P_M) %}
create_noc_connection -source $p2p_nmu_{{ g }} -target $p2p_nsu_{{ h }}
{% endfor %}
{% endfor %}
{% endif %}
